description: LangChain create_agent with one tool and two model turns, traced by OpenLLMetry.
notes: TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on spans as gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false. These packages have no TRACELOOP_TELEMETRY switch. Only LangchainInstrumentor is enabled. The agent is langchain.agents.create_agent. ChatOpenAI is pointed at the mock. The capture keeps eight spans: invoke_agent LangGraph, the workflow, a model task, the LLM, a tools task, the tool, then the model task and LLM again. LLM token counts are copied: input 82 then 131, output 17 then 12, cache_read 0 then 64. Finish reasons are tool_call, then stop. langgraph_checkpoint_ns is a hash of the checkpoint id. Run, message, and checkpoint ids are pinned to a counter, and a second capture matches.
